What's Inside

Built for people who outgrow one model

Every capability lives in the same thread — no tab-switching, no separate subscriptions, no re-explaining yourself to a different chatbot.

Multi-Model Intelligence

Switch between GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, and Mistral mid-conversation — pick the right mind for the task, not just the one you're used to.

Grounded Web Search

Every claim comes with a source. Chorus searches the live web and shows its work, so you can verify instead of guess.

Image & Music Generation

Turn a prompt into a picture or a track — DALL·E, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX for images; Udio and Suno for original music.

Built to Move Fast

Streaming responses, instant model switching, and a command palette (⌘K) so your hands never leave the keyboard.

Yours, Wherever You Are

Conversations and settings persist locally and sync your theme, so you pick up exactly where you left off.

Reads What You Give It

Drop in a PDF or paste a link. Chorus reads it, summarizes it, and answers questions against it.

See It Work

Answers you can actually verify

A real exchange, start to finish — the model, the answer, and exactly where it came from.

Y
You · asked Chorus
Compare DeepSeek V4 and Claude Sonnet for refactoring a large TypeScript codebase.
Chorus · grounded answer

DeepSeek V4 tends to be faster and cheaper for mechanical refactors — renames, type migrations, repetitive edits across many files. Claude Sonnet holds more context and reasons better about cross-file architectural changes where a mistake would ripple. For a large, tangled codebase, most teams run Sonnet for the plan and DeepSeek for bulk execution.

Getting Started

Three steps, no waiting on approval

Chorus doesn't sell you a seat — it's the interface. You bring the model access; Chorus makes it usable.

01

Connect your key

Add an OpenRouter key once. Chorus never sees or stores it anywhere but your own browser.

02

Pick your model

Start with a fast, cheap model and switch to something heavier the moment a question deserves it.

03

Just start typing

Chat, search, generate an image, or draft a track — same thread, same shortcut, zero context lost.

Straight Answers

Before you ask

A single chat interface that routes your questions to GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, or Mistral — plus web search, image generation, and music generation, all in one thread.

No. Pasting in an API key is the only setup step — after that it works like any chat app.

Conversations and settings are kept in your browser's local storage. Nothing is sent anywhere except directly to the model provider you chose.

Yes — DALL·E, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX for images; Udio and Suno for music, from the same chat window.

No — set a default and switch only when a question calls for something heavier or cheaper.

Chorus itself is free and open — you only pay the model provider for what you actually use, at their rates.
